source.text: The 2026 canal lantern walk is booked for November 14. Need stewards, a route permit and a rain plan for this edition.
OCR: Canal Lantern Walk 2026 route draft. Begin at East Lock, finish at the boat shed; steward point beside the footbridge.
Feed the neglected starter twice today and mark its starting level. The jar smells fruity, without visible mold.

events.text: OCR corrected: Canal Lantern Walk 2026 route draft. Begin at East Lock, finish at the boat shed; steward point before the footbridge, not beside its centre.

source.text: 2026 lantern walk permit granted for East Lock to boat shed. Rain plan switches to the covered towpath without changing the event date.
2026 canal lantern walk recording: stewards redirect walkers to the covered towpath; the boat-shed welcome table stays dry.
2026 closeout: the covered section worked, but the finish table was too narrow. Leave this observation in this year's review.
Fresh commission: 2027 canal lantern walk, November 13, separate budget and volunteer roster. We may reuse the 2026 route template.
Move the welcome table to the wider bay.
Handover between editions: 2026's narrow finish-table lesson becomes a proposed wider bay for the 2027 lantern walk. Keep each edition's budget separate.
My welcome-table fragment was a decision for the 2027 walk, not an edit to the 2026 closeout. Put it with the new edition's setup plan.

events.reason: c10 explicitly identifies the table move as a 2027 setup decision. Assign the fragment to that edition.

source.text: 2027 setup sketch: welcome table in the wider boat-shed bay, two volunteer chairs, queue kept away from the exit.
2027 walk supplier quote accepted for reusable lantern sleeves. This purchase is charged only to the 2027 event budget.
